Screen capture is not supported on this Android version. Requires Android 13+.

1. Add the app to Smart Sidebar (Settings → Smart Sidebar → customize).\n2. Pin/lock the app in recents so ColorOS keeps it running.\n3. Enable the capture service once. A sidebar tap then captures the screen and opens Google Lens.
Captures screenshots for Google Lens. When you explicitly run the J1 diagnostic, also inspects Lens controls for up to 10 seconds and activates Translate at most once.

After updating, turn the capture accessibility service OFF and ON once using the settings button below to enable UI interaction. J1 captures this screen, opens Lens, then looks for its English Translate button/filter for up to 10 seconds and activates it once. Do not tap Lens while it runs. Return here to see the J1 report at the top; it is also included in the dump. I1 is the working translation-camera reference (no screenshot). H1/H2 do not capture; the other probes require the capture service.
Accessibility settings (turn service off/on after update)
